heading level 2, When to use this component
Always show an error summary when there is a validation error, even if there's only one.
. move keyboard focus to the error summary (the govuk-frontend javascript will do this for you), 1 of 4
• include the heading 'There is a problem', 2 of 4
. link to each of the answers that have validation errors, 3 of 4
• make sure the error messages in the error summary are worded the same as those which appear next to the inputs with errors, 4 of 4
As well as showing an error summary, follow the
- for example, by adding 'Error: "to the beginning of the page
so screen readers read it out as soon as possible.
